# PR #3644: Patch: dungeon HP refills after every fight, and each win adds 5 max HP

Closes #3584

## What changed

Every won fight of any kind adds `RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` (5) to a new `RunState.max_hp_bonus` and refills HP to the new max, so HP outside a fight always equals max HP and every fight starts full. A lost fight still drops HP to 0 and ends the run. Events trade max HP (`RunEventOption.hp` renamed to `max_hp`, refused below max HP 1 with "not enough max HP"), and the campfire's heal is now "+5 max HP" (`RunAction::Heal` renamed to `GainMaxHp`, `RUN_CAMPFIRE_HEAL_PERCENT` retired, `RUN_CAMPFIRE_MAX_HP` added, exposed as `RunConstants.campfire_max_hp`). Placeholder events, the HUD (HP shows max only), campfire/event words, `zh-CN.json`, `run-sim` (final-HP accounting, "max HP entering boss" lines), spec §15 (table, §15.4/§15.6/§15.7/§15.8/§15.12), `docs/dungeon-run.md` (DR0.3, DR7), `crates/run/README.md`, and rulings R3584000/R3584001 with `spec/pending/3584.md` are all updated. No engine change, no kept-run handling (that is #3496's).

## In-fight healing finding (for the PR notes)

A hero starting above `HERO_HEALTH` can heal past its starting health inside a fight: `heal_hero` is uncapped for heroes (`crates/engine/src/damage.rs`: "units are capped at max health, heroes are not"), and `validate_setup` requires only `hero_health >= 1` with no upper cap. The engine is unchanged here, as instructed.

**The owner's new rules (`crates/run`):**

- **Every fight won**, of any kind and bosses included, raises the run's max HP by `RUN_WIN_MAX_HP` (5) for the rest of the run, then refills HP to the new max, whatever the hero's final health was.
